segment_summary.zh: 从A处沿白色空间向前推进，低矮媒体/储物柜位于左侧并逐渐退到画面左下；随后路线靠近右侧的洗手台、镜柜和狭窄门洞，B停在或接近该门洞处。全程未见电视、棕色椅子、盆栽或窗户。
segment_summary.en: From A, the robot advanced through the white space; the low media/storage console stayed on the left and receded toward the lower left. The route then approached a vanity/sink, mirror cabinet, and narrow doorway on the right, with B at or near that doorway. No TV, brown chair, potted plant, or window was seen.

reason.zh: 任务要求右转后让电视和媒体柜位于右侧，再穿过门洞直行，经过右侧棕色椅子和左侧盆栽后停在窗前。F8/F15显示低矮媒体/储物柜在左侧并被向前经过；F21–F33的路线靠近右侧洗手台和窄门洞，未见任务地标，因此与要求冲突。
reason.en: The task requires turning right so that the TV and media console are on the right, then walking through the doorway and continuing straight past a brown chair on the right and a potted plant on the left, stopping in front of the window. Frames F8/F15 show the low media/storage console on the left as the robot moves forward past it; the route in F21–F33 approaches a vanity and narrow doorway on the right, without the task landmarks, so it conflicts with the requirement.

instruction_evidence.quote_en: Turn right, passing the TV and media console on your right.
instruction_evidence.quote_zh: 右转，从右侧经过电视和媒体柜。

instruction_evidence.quote_en: Walk forward through the doorway into the next room.
instruction_evidence.quote_zh: 向前穿过门洞进入下一个房间。

instruction_evidence.quote_en: Continue straight, passing a brown chair on your right and a potted plant on your left, and stop in front of the window.
instruction_evidence.quote_zh: 继续直行，从右侧经过一把棕色椅子、从左侧经过一盆盆栽，然后停在窗前。

description.zh: F8和F15显示低矮媒体/储物柜位于左侧；随着机器人前进，它退向左下角，且未见电视位于右侧。
description.en: F8 and F15 show the low media/storage console on the left; as the robot advances, it recedes toward the lower left, and no TV is seen on the right.

description.zh: 机器人靠近带洗手台和镜柜的区域，洗手台在右侧；前方是一个狭窄的白色门洞。
description.en: The robot approaches a vanity and mirror-cabinet area, with the vanity on the right; ahead is a narrow white doorway.

description.zh: 终点B处在狭窄门洞/米色开口附近，右侧仍可见洗手台边缘；画面中未见窗户。
description.en: Endpoint B is near the narrow doorway/beige opening, with the edge of the vanity still visible on the right; no window is visible.

uncertainties.zh: 仅凭B处单帧无法确认机器人是否已跨过窄门洞的阈值。
uncertainties.en: It cannot be confirmed from the single B frame whether the robot has crossed the threshold of the narrow doorway.

uncertainties.zh: 该洗手台区域与任务所说“下一个房间”的对应关系尚未确认。
uncertainties.en: The correspondence between this vanity area and the task's 'next room' has not been confirmed.
